page.content:
The scripture-seeking party: master, three disciples, and the dragon horse.

How Tang pilgrimage connects

  • Character: Tang Sanzang — Sanzang is master of the scripture pilgrimage.
  • Character: Sun Wukong — Wukong is the senior disciple of the pilgrimage.
  • Character: Guanyin — Guanyin assembled the disciples and bound them to Sanzang.
  • Character: Zhu Bajie — Bajie is the second disciple of the pilgrimage.
  • Character: Sha Wujing — Wujing is the third disciple of the pilgrimage.
  • Event: Eighty-one tribulations — The tribulations are the ordeals counted against the pilgrims.
  • Character: White Dragon Horse — The White Dragon Horse is the fifth pilgrim.
  • Location: Thunderclap Monastery — The pilgrims' road ends at Thunderclap Monastery.

What is Tang pilgrimage?

The Tang pilgrimage is the traveling household Guanyin assembles: Sanzang, Wukong, Bajie, Wujing, and the White Dragon Horse, bound to fetch Mahayana texts from the West.

Key threads lead to Tang Sanzang, Sun Wukong, Guanyin, Zhu Bajie, Sha Wujing and Eighty-one tribulations.
